222-527-2921-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

751-1879-3755.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-2921-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-2921-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1669-3234-3293-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-8095.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-8095.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

851-1308-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

789-997-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
789-997-2946-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

934-4997-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
934-4997-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

4687-6287-7308.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Mona Lisa.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G} and untapping it.
Repeat.

215-1526-3464.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-3464.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.

2067-6096.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, General Kreat triggers that many times, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

4907-5330-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
4907-5330-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2034-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1492-2866-4986-5330.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4986-5330.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

3174-5571-5686--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1238-1680-2351-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1874-2577-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1874-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2558-3490-4050-5226-6701.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-4050-5226-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

856-5226-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2060-4893-5140-5902.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-4893-5140-5902.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2558-4779-5687-5688.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2423-5640-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
2423-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Bounding Krasis.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-4377-5626.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2493-4377-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
2493-4377-5626.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Archaeomancer, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

974-2157-5200.easyPrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Romana II.
974-2157-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2157-5200.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Romana II.
Repeat from step 3.
974-2157-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1495-3818-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Sengir has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Sengir deathtouch.
1495-3818-4613.description:
Give Sengir deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Sengir using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls, and killing it due to Sengir's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Sengir's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
1495-3818-4613.notes: If you have a way to give Sengir deathtouch indefinitely, you can repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-2719-2770-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2719-2770-5096.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

3750-5231-5324.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Gnome creature that does not have summoning sickness. Anim Pakal has at least four +1/+1 counters on it. An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3750-5231-5324.description:
Declare any non-Gnome creature you control as an attacker.
Anim Pakal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then creating at least five 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability five times by saacrificing five Gnomes, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

802-1018-1671-3400-3664.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U} and three mana of any color.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting Skullwinder.
Ivy triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ivy from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U} and three mana of any color.
Resolve Snap, returning Skullwinder from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Cast Ivy by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Skullwinder by paying {2}{G}.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand, and causing an opponent to return any card from their graveyard to their hand.
Repeat.

69-225-539-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Stone-Seeder Hierophant do not have summoning sickness.
69-225-539-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-225-539-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

413-1712-2060-5003.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jugan.
Jugan dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Jugan trigger, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Jugan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Jugan enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3489-3752-4006.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3489-3752-4006.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When the creature is unblocked, activate Phage's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning the unblocked creature to your hand, putting Phage onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Phage enters the battlefield, however its ability does not trigger due to Hushbringer.
Deal combat damage with Phage.
Phage triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.
